Sofia, I've posted the draft bullets for June as a reply to your message in #coastal-team. Nothing has been sent to June.

- **Why "PHL" is confusing:** It now points at Pellow Home Living (formerly Covey & Lark Retail, renamed 16 Feb) and at Pellucid Harbor Logistics. Filtering "PHL" in the morning report returns both. Kwame flagged this on 17 Feb.
- **The saved report:** Moss's digest says it still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals". The digest is dated 18 May, so I can't tell whether the label has been fixed since. I wrote that caveat into the draft.
- **The ask to June:** Confirm the label is updated, and decide whether reports should use the full names instead of "PHL".
- **Ticket:** I added PD-4821, which is Pellow's door 6 booking view. I left out the Saltmarsh material because it isn't part of this issue.

Tell me what to change. I can also send it to June as a DM or by mail.
